definitions.gloss: tea whisk; bamboo whisk used to prepare matcha
definitions.explanation: A small whisk carved from a single piece of bamboo, with fine tines splayed outward, used in the Japanese tea ceremony to whisk powdered green tea ({抹茶|まっちゃ}) into hot water. The splitting of the bamboo into many thin tines is what gives the whisk its characteristic shape and frothing ability.

examples.japanese: {茶筅|ちゃせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Whisk the matcha with a tea whisk.

examples.japanese: {茶筅|ちゃせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{湿|しめ}らせて→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧おく。
examples.english: Moisten the tea whisk with hot water before using it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高山|たかやま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{茶筅|ちゃせん}づくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られ→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{穂先|ほさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}り{出|だ}す→割り出す：11914_waridasu⟧。
examples.english: Takayama in Nara Prefecture is known as a production center for tea whisks, where artisans carefully split the tines out of a single piece of bamboo.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ ('tea') and {筅|せん} ('whisk; brush'). The character {筅} is used almost exclusively in this word.

USAGE:
- Tightly associated with the tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧). The whisk is one of the core utensils alongside ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧ ('tea bowl'), ⟦{茶杓|ちゃしゃく}→茶杓：23830_chashaku⟧ ('tea scoop'), and {棗|なつめ} ('tea caddy').
- The verb for using a tea whisk to prepare matcha is ⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧, as in ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧ ('to make tea [in the ceremonial way]'). Using ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ ('to brew') with {茶筅|ちゃせん} sounds unnatural.
- Number of tines varies by school and style: {数穂|かずほ} (many tines, ~80) for everyday use vs. fewer-tined whisks for thicker {濃茶|こいちゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧: to whisk (matcha) with a chasen
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to move the whisk (in the whisking motion)
- {茶筅|ちゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{湿|しめ}らせる→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧: to moisten the whisk
- {茶筅通|ちゃせんとお}し: the preparatory step of warming and inspecting the whisk
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶筅|ちゃせん}: a brand-new tea whisk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶杓|ちゃしゃく}→茶杓：23830_chashaku⟧: tea scoop — the bamboo scoop used to measure matcha powder out of the caddy.
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧: tea bowl — in the tea ceremony, the bowl in which the matcha is whisked; in everyday life, also 'rice bowl'.
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧: matcha — the powdered green tea that is whisked with a {茶筅|ちゃせん}.
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}→泡立て器：08066_awadateki⟧: (ordinary) whisk — a Western-style wire whisk used in cooking; not a substitute for {茶筅|ちゃせん} in the tea ceremony.
